name: Aritzia Annual Warehouse Sale
transitAccess: 3 min walk from Waterfront SkyTrain (Expo & Canada Line)
parkingInfo: VCC West Parkade ($24 daily max) or Cordova Parkade

schedule.notes: Opening Day - doors open early 7 AM
Major inventory restock
Peak weekend crowds
Further mid-sale markdowns
Labour Day Holiday - final deep reductions
Final Clearance - additional 20% off selected racks

lineupAdvice: Peak queues start at 5:30 AM on opening Thursday/Friday. For minimal wait, visit between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM on weekday afternoons.
bagPolicy: Strict bag check: No backpacks, large totes, or luggage permitted inside. Free mandatory coat & bag check available at entrance.
fittingRoomInfo: Communal fitting rooms only. Undergarments/base layers recommended for trying on over clothes.
returnPolicy: Final sale on all merchandise. No refunds, returns, or price adjustments.

name: Arc'teryx Factory Outlet Sale
venueAddress: 2155 Dollarton Hwy, North Vancouver, BC V7H 3B8
transitAccess: Bus #212 or #214 from Phibbs Exchange (10 min ride)
parkingInfo: Free on-site customer parking and overflow street parking along Riverside Dr

schedule.notes: Timed ticket slots (1h browsing windows)
Morning inventory refresh
Walk-in standby queue based on capacity
Final Day - sample prototypes & discontinued colorways

lineupAdvice: Reserve a free timed entry pass online 48 hours prior to skip the general standby line.
bagPolicy: Small personal purses and fanny packs permitted. Large backpacks must be checked in vehicle.
fittingRoomInfo: Individual fitting cubicles available with 4-item limit per session.
returnPolicy: All sales final. Factory second blemishes clearly marked on tags.

name: Herschel Supply Co. Sample Sale
transitAccess: Bus #3 (Main St) or #9 / #99 B-Line (Broadway) 5 min walk
parkingInfo: Metered street parking along Main St & East 15th Ave

schedule.notes: Opening morning - large luggage & travel gear drop
Backpack & accessory restock
Final Day - bundle deals (Buy 2 Get 1 Free)

lineupAdvice: Morning lineup along East 15th Ave moves quickly. Arrive around 11:30 AM for steady entry without peak queues.
bagPolicy: Clear bags provided at entrance for shopping. Personal backpacks tagged upon arrival.
fittingRoomInfo: No apparel fitting rooms. Outerwear mirror stations only.
returnPolicy: Final sale on all backpacks, luggage, and apparel.

name: Vancouver Ski & Snowboard Swap
venueAddress: 2901 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5K 5J1
transitAccess: Bus #14, #16, or R5 RapidBus directly to Hastings at Renfrew
parkingInfo: PNE Lot 6 ($15 event flat rate) or neighborhood residential zones

schedule.notes: $5 Early Bird Admission supports volunteer Ski Patrol
Consignment price markdowns (25% off tagged prices)
Final Clearance & uncollected gear return

lineupAdvice: Early Saturday ticket holders get first pick of freshly certified ski and snowboard bindings. On-site certified technicians adjust DIN settings.
bagPolicy: Skis and poles must be checked at the safety gear staging rack upon entry.
fittingRoomInfo: Boot fitting benches with certified boot fitters on site.
returnPolicy: All gear sold AS-IS inspected by Canadian Ski Patrol safety team. Final sale.

name: VanDusen Botanical Garden Fall Plant Sale
transitAccess: Bus #17 (Oak St at West 37th Ave) directly at entrance
parkingInfo: Free visitor parking lot on West 37th Ave (limited capacity during sale)

schedule.notes: One day only - master gardeners on site for consultation

lineupAdvice: Arrive with your own wagon or transport box. Lineup begins at 9:15 AM at the Floral Hall gate.
bagPolicy: Bring your own cardboard boxes, plastic flats, or garden wagons.
fittingRoomInfo: Not applicable (plant holding area available while shopping).
returnPolicy: Living plant material is final sale.

name: DUER Performance Denim Pop-up Warehouse Sale
transitAccess: 5 min walk from Commercial-Broadway SkyTrain Station
parkingInfo: Free spacious on-site parking lot behind the cultural centre

schedule.notes: First pick of stretch denim & performance trousers
Mid-sale restock of commuter joggers & jackets
Final Day - 3 for $150 special bundle tables

lineupAdvice: Commercial-Broadway SkyTrain access makes transit the fastest way to arrive. Lines are brisk with minimal wait times.
bagPolicy: Coat check available. Small personal bags allowed.
fittingRoomInfo: Individual fitting cubicles with mirror corridor.
returnPolicy: Final sale on all warehouse and sample stock.

name: Le Creuset Factory-to-Table Clearance
transitAccess: 3 min walk from Waterfront SkyTrain Station
parkingInfo: Canada Place underground parking ($26 daily maximum)

schedule.notes: VIP mystery box sessions (ticketed)
Cast iron, stoneware & enameled cookware
Specialty Dutch oven colorways & bakers
Final Day - deep stoneware discounts

lineupAdvice: Ticketed time slots ensure zero outdoor queue. Have your digital barcode ready at the East Building entrance.
bagPolicy: Heavy-duty shopping carts provided. Heavy items delivered to loading staging area.
returnPolicy: All cast iron and stoneware sales final. First-quality and factory seconds clearly designated.

name: MEC Vancouver Annual Snow & Bike Gear Swap
transitAccess: 5 min walk from Main St-Science World or Olympic Village SkyTrain
parkingInfo: Underground customer parking at MEC (1h free with purchase)

schedule.notes: Member consignment drop & primary gear swap
Final markdowns & sample clearance tables

lineupAdvice: Queue forms on the 2nd Ave ramp before 8:30 AM. Bike racks are plentiful outside the entrance.
bagPolicy: Shopping bags provided. Used gear brought for trade-in must be tagged at ground desk.
fittingRoomInfo: Store fitting rooms available on 1st & 2nd floors.
returnPolicy: Gear swap consignment items are final sale.
